Mental health platform

MindfulTech

UI/UX designer · 2024 to 2025

FigmaWireframingPrototyping

Overview

MindfulTech is a mental health platform concept built around calm, clarity and trust. I designed the experience in Figma, from wireframes to a high-fidelity prototype, with soft visuals and gentle interactions.

The challenge

Wellbeing apps can feel overwhelming. The design needed to be calm, easy to navigate and never pushy, so people feel comfortable using it.

Design process

  1. 1

    Researched the tone and visual language of calm, trustworthy products.

  2. 2

    Wireframed the main journeys with as few steps as possible.

  3. 3

    Designed soft, accessible high-fidelity screens.

  4. 4

    Prototyped the flows and checked them for clarity.

Key design features

Calm, low-stimulation visual style

Simple navigation

Readable typography and spacing

Consistent component library

Outcome

A gentle, accessible prototype that puts the user at ease.
